rule: R54's Japan view table (R54_japan_view.csv, MOFA). The name shown is MOFA's short form where MOFA gives one, else its name; MOFA's formal form, R54's general-usage aliases and NE's names in other languages are aliases. Status: recognised state -> state; Japan -> self; region (地域) -> region; not recognised (UN member) -> not_recognised; not listed -> not_listed with MOFA's text name. The 13 dependent territories are territory of their administering state, named as MOFA names them (R55_territory_names.csv, 10 of 13; its first form); CUW, ABW and TCA in general usage, marked not MOFA. Rows that are no field entity (topics, de-facto entities inside their host, Crimea, Kashmir) are kept as notes.
counts_source: MOFA's count of recognised states (195) and the R54 entity list: a standing fact, unchanged since 2015-05-15; the page R53 read is a capture made after 2024 (R96e), so the value is CHECK until an in-window capture confirms it (verifyくん; the PM, TO_E 21:11 1(d))
